findings.title: pnpm add/update/remove/link not in deny list — shared node_modules poisonable via worktree symlink
findings.detail: WORKER_CLAUDE_PERMISSIONS.deny in src/pipeline/factory.ts blocked 'pnpm install' and 'pnpm install *' (AUDIT-IFleet-bfa22380) but left pnpm add, pnpm update, pnpm remove, and pnpm link unblocked. All four commands mutate node_modules in the same way pnpm install does and resolve through the worktree symlink to the shared host node_modules, allowing a jailbroken worker to install arbitrary packages visible to all concurrent tasks. The allow list contains 'Bash(pnpm *)' which supersedes the install deny for any unlisted subcommand, so the gap is immediately exploitable.
findings.fix_sketch: Add bare and wildcard deny entries for pnpm add, pnpm update, pnpm remove, and pnpm link alongside the existing pnpm install entries.
